presets.name: Google Workspace
presets.help: Create an OAuth client of type Web application in your Google Cloud project, then paste its client ID and secret.

presets.name: Microsoft Entra ID
presets.help: Register an app for web sign-in, replace {tenant-id} with your directory's id, and add a client secret.

presets.name: Okta
presets.help: Create an OIDC web app integration and paste its client ID and secret. SAML works too: choose Other SAML 2.0.

presets.name: Keycloak
presets.help: Create a confidential OpenID Connect client in your realm and copy its secret from the Credentials tab.

presets.name: Authentik
presets.help: Create an OAuth2/OpenID provider and an application for it, then paste the client ID and secret.

presets.name: Other OpenID Connect
presets.help: Any provider that publishes /.well-known/openid-configuration under its issuer URL.

presets.name: Other SAML 2.0
presets.help: Paste the identity provider's entity ID, single sign-on URL and signing certificate from its metadata.
